title: LibraryMatchSuggestionsRequestDTOV3_MatchSuggestions
description: Request payload for retrieving Mend library suggestions for source files. Requires sourceFileUuids and recommendedForAllFiles. Medium privilege users can optionally specify repository and version fields for more targeted suggestions.

items.title: Source File UUIDs
items.description: List of source file UUIDs for which to get Mend library suggestions. Required field.

recommendedForAllFiles.title: Recommended For All Files
recommendedForAllFiles.description: Flag indicating whether to get recommendations that apply to all specified files. Required field.
